hypothesis: HT-Breakout entries whose completed five-minute breakout direction agrees with the completed-hour structural direction may outperform entries where those directions oppose after live costs.
decision: Continue rejecting a five-minute direction-agreement gate and retain exact breakout-side relation as telemetry. The expanded all-live record now has 11 attributable HT-Breakout closes across BTC, ETH, HYPE, and SOL: all four aligned trades lost, while five of seven opposed trades lost. Both groups are materially negative after actual fees and funding, and the seven older unattributable closes prevent complete prospective coverage. The stronger live asymmetry is side-and-market specific—eight HYPE longs are positive in aggregate while ten shorts across the four core assets are negative—but that is a small, time-confounded research hypothesis for a separately predeclared challenger, not evidence that direction agreement fixes the route.
falsifier: Reconsider direction agreement only if a predeclared prospective sample with complete causal breakout-side coverage produces positive aligned after-cost outcomes, materially outperforms opposed entries, and confirms on a purged unopened venue window under the same entry and exit contract. Reconsider the side-and-market hypothesis if new HYPE longs lose or core-asset shorts become positive after costs in repeated independent samples.
limitations: Only 11 of 18 live HT-Breakout closes have exact causal breakout-side relation coverage, and profile generation is confounded with telemetry availability.
The aligned and opposed samples are both small and both negative; their 0.083-percentage-point mean difference is not economically meaningful evidence.
HYPE long versus core-asset short performance is not a randomized side comparison and may reflect market regime, asset, profile, notional, or observation-window differences.
No HT-Breakout long has yet closed on BTC, ETH, or SOL, so asset transfer symmetry is untested rather than disproven.
The 365-day replay uses fixed modeled friction and cannot establish private live IOC fills, queue position, funding, or future performance.
This journal revision grants no gating, ranking, sizing, routing, exit, or promotion authority.
